notes: Apollo is targeting up to $20B of private-credit deployment into Mexican infrastructure and corporate borrowers over time, offering faster execution / longer maturities than local commercial or development banks. Explicitly a target, not a committed fund or single transaction -- no finalized pipeline or timetable disclosed, capital would be deployed gradually across many deals. All outlets found trace to the same Bloomberg origin (circular-reporting guard), so graded candidate on a single source despite wide pickup. Prior Apollo Mexico precedent: $300M senior secured note for a Mexico Infrastructure Partners trust (power plants ex-Iberdrola).

Blue Owl's data-center platform Stack Infrastructure is in early-stage talks with a bank syndicate for an A$8.5B (~US$5.9B) loan to fund its third Melbourne, Australia data center. Not yet closed ('talks... at an early stage, details may change'), and the actual lending capital would come from the bank syndicate, not from Blue Owl directly -- filed as a weak/indirect candidate on Stack's balance sheet rather than a confirmed Blue Owl capital deployment. Follows an AU$1.3B green-financing round DCD reported earlier for the same Melbourne campus and a $2.1B Stack loan in Feb 2026, part of a pattern of Blue Owl-sponsored Stack debt raises.
